This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Simmered Fruits are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] a maximum of three different [[Fruit]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. There are two ways to make this dish's default version. First, either [[Apple]]s, [[Palm Fruit]]s, or [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] must be used without any status-altering Fruits. Alternatively, [[Link]] can use multiple Fruits with contradicting status effects. If consumed, Simmered Fruits will restore at least one of his [[Heart]]s. They have a sweet taste, and the Fruits are simmered until tender. Link can use certain Fruits, in addition to extra [[Ingredient]]s, to make different variations of Simmered Fruits: * '''Hearty Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Simmered Fruit}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Durian]]s or other hearty Ingredients. By eating them, Link can have all of his Hearts healed and his maximum Hearts temporarily increased. * '''Energizing Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Simmered Fruit}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. When eaten, they will refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Simmered Fruit}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. Link can eat these fruits to completely restore and overfill his Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Simmered Fruit}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] or other hasty Ingredients. If Link eats them, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Spicy Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Spicy Pepper]]s or other spicy Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfruit]]s or other electric Ingredients. They can be eaten to give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Simmered Fruit}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Bananas]] or other mighty Ingredients. These fruits will boost the power of Link's attacks when eaten. * '''Tough Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Simmered Fruit}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using tough Ingredients. Eating these meals will increase Link's defensive abilities. * '''Sneaky Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Simmered Fruit}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they'll increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Simmered Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Simmered Fruit}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This sweet dish is made by heaping tasty fruits into a pan and simmering until tender.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hydromelon]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Consuming them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Simmered Fruits can be made by [[Cooking]] up to three different types of [[Fruit]] together. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Simmered Fruit * Food * Meal * Steamed Fruit }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
